name: Hanayoi Romanesque~ Ai to Kanashimi - Sore wa Kimi no Tame no Aria
original_name: 花宵ロマネスク 愛と哀しみ―それは君のためのアリア
source: The player character, Kirihara Tamami, is a teacher at the historical Gekka Academy, where various male members of the Houshou family reside as staff and students. This family has the 'Logos' curse on them, and Tamami is able to see this curse. Gameplay revolves around Tamami taking various forms of the curse and hopefully releasing them in the correct way to free the guys from it.
translation: 玩家扮演桐原珠美，她是历史悠久的月华学园教师。宝生家族的多名男性成员以教职员或学生身份居住在校内。这个家族背负名为“Logos”的诅咒，而珠美能够看见它。游戏围绕珠美接纳诅咒的不同形态，并设法以正确方式释放它们，帮助男性角色摆脱诅咒展开。
